description: This Dart file defines the HomeController class for a Flutter application. It manages the state and data loading logic for the home screen, including fetching the home feed and 'continue watching' list, handling cache updates, and notifying listeners of state changes.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state and data retrieval for the home screen, including handling cache updates, loading home feed content, and 'continue watching' entries.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the home feed, updating state and notifying listeners; performs background refresh of data.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Retrieves recent watch history, fetches associated content details, and updates the 'continue watching' list.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the 'continue watching' list after playback progress is saved.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Reloads home feed and continue watching list when cache is refreshed.
